notes.title: v1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Just a minor patch, folks. Like changin' the bobber, not the bait.

Updated Humpback Whitefish spawns to reliably spawn S and M sizes

Added camera toggle button for gamepad (L3) and keyboard (C)

Legendary fish will spawn again after a day (20hrs real time)

Reduced the chance larger fish will eat the fish on your hook

Fixed "catch fish with a fish" completing when it shouldn't

Fixed edge case where "catch fish above water" achievements wouldn't complete

notes.title: v1.0.2 Fish Fighting Update
notes.content:
Howdy folks, and thanks for playing! Since launch, we’ve been reading your feedback and working hard on an update focused on refining the fish fighting mechanics and adding some fun new features.


🎣 Fish Fighting Improvements
You can now let your line go slack and see it with clear visual cues to help you manage tension and avoid over-pulling. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/b2f6ba4d4f79b2cf50a96b763839a30093467388.gif"]

We’ve also added the ability to steer and guide the fish slightly when pulling at just the right time and improved bubble particles to let you know when the fish is thrashing easier.


🐟 Smarter Fish Behaviour
 Fish no longer sprint endlessly in one direction or head butt the lakebed. Their movement is now more natural and satisfying.


🧍 New Angler Animations

We’ve added some lovely new animations to bring your angler to life with more personality.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/2286b847e880c04b86c485fbe55f915bd94618d2.gif"]
⚙️ Idle Mode Enhancements

You can now tweak Idle Mode to limit what can be caught passively.
And introducing Screensaver Mode – no progression, no sales, no achievements. Just relax and enjoy the scenery.


🐶 New Pupper Option

There’s a new good doggo to choose from: a loyal German Shepherd companion.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/e5b4749c1ed18667c6e288e320140d833056549d.gif"]


Thank you to everyone who helped Beta test this update!

notes.title: Cast n Chill - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/c44983b20ffa4cfa8ed953bce80c2a4e7834072a.png"]🔧 Patch Notes - v1.0.1

🕘 Idle Mode Changes
Lure & rod are automatically selected to match the fish at that location, after trying your current lure/rod at least once

Automatic selection of lure is a setting that can be turned off (same as v1.0.0)

Legendary fish no longer try to bite the lure in idle mode

Improved determining a new fishing spot based on rod & lure

Fish bite much quicker (matches the speed in active mode)

Fish caught in idle sell for half the coins (to balance the increased catch speed)

 
🎣 Gameplay Tweaks
Show the fish size as soon as the fish is caught (i.e. before storing / releasing)

 
🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed achievements not unlocking immediately (or at all, in some cases)

Fixed steering wheels/joysticks/stray gamepads interfering with game input

Fixed mouse movement + keyboard driving causing the boat to stop

Fixed Longnose Dace trophy size and spawn rate

Fixed language not saving between game restarts

Fixed power loss sometimes causing save game corruption

 
⚡ Graphics
Optimisations to save a TON of GPU processing (over 75% less GPU!)

Added resolution dropdown for fullscreen mode

 
🎨 Visuals & UI
Added trophy icon to fish tiles in the book if trophy weight has been caught

Moved character (costume + companion) button to main menu

Added two variations for the Alaskan Malamute 

Added another variation for the Basset Hound

 
🎵 Audio
Added a master volume slider

Reduced UI sound volume

notes.title: Cast n Chill Demo v2 is Live
notes.content:
Hey there folks,

A big thank you to everyone who filled out our feedback form or dropped suggestions in the Steam forums, your thoughts have been incredibly helpful in shaping this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/f9167243fbc2d39251b258a532277f94940e909b.png

We’ve just released a new version of the Cast n Chill demo packed with features you asked for. Whether it was improving fishing mechanics, adding new content, or making the game even more relaxing to play, we’ve listened, and here’s what’s new:

NEW FEATURES

  Fawnmirror Lake – A tranquil new location to explore, unlocked via fishing license
  5 New Fish, 1 New Rod, 5 New Lures – Expand your gear and discover new species to catch
  Idle Mode – Let the game cast for you while you chill and enjoy a calming, passive experience
  Vertical Mode – Resize the window to sit neatly on the side of your screen
  Zoom Out Option – Get a taller view of the stunning landscapes and soak in more scenery
  Refined Fishing Mechanics – Improved line controls and a new lure system linking lures to rods
  Fish Battle Balancing – Reeling in fish now feels more responsive and rewarding (the fish get tired!)
  Nibbles – Fish may nibble without biting, use the right lure to hook the species you’re after
  Fish Discovery & Logbook – Find new fish to unlock their details in your logbook and research the best lure to use
  Character Customiser – Shuffle your look with a randomiser (full customisation coming soon)
  New Music & Soundscapes – Tranquil new music and improved natural soundscapes to deepen your relaxation


This update is a big step toward the cozy fishing experience we’ve all been imagining, and it wouldn’t be possible without your feedback. If you get a chance to try the demo again, we’d love to hear what you think!

Thanks for being part of the journey,
 - Team Wombat Brawler
